heading: For Cause
verbatim_text: If Subcontractor fails to perform and does not cure within three (3) working days after written notice, Contractor may terminate or supplement the Work and charge the cost to Subcontractor.
trigger_desc: after written notice, Contractor may terminate or supplement the Work and charge the cost to Subcontractor

heading: Time of Payment
verbatim_text: Contractor shall pay Subcontractor the amount approved, less retainage, within **seven (7) days after Contractor receives payment from Owner** for the Work covered by the application.
trigger_desc: after Contractor receives payment from Owner for the Work covered by the application

heading: Notice of Non-Payment
verbatim_text: If payment is not received when due under Section 3.3, Subcontractor shall give Contractor **written notice of non-payment within ten (10) days of the missed due date**. Timely written notice is a **condition precedent** to any claim for payment, interest or suspension of Work arising from the late payment. This notice does not replace any statutory notice required to preserve lien or bond rights.

Retainage shall be released **thirty (30) days after Owner's final acceptance** of the Project and Subcontractor's delivery of all **closeout documents** required by Article 9, a final unconditional lien waiver, and consent of surety if applicable.
trigger_desc: after Owner's final acceptance of the Project and Subcontractor's delivery of all closeout documents required by Article 9, a final unconditional lien waiver, and consent of surety if applicable

verbatim_text: Subcontractor shall submit all shop drawings, product data, and samples **within twenty-one (21) calendar days after Notice to Proceed**.
Submittals for **long-lead equipment, including switchgear, switchboards and panelboards, shall be submitted within ten (10) calendar days after Notice to Proceed**.

Subcontractor shall allow **fourteen (14) calendar days for Architect review** of each submittal. Rejected or "revise and resubmit" submittals shall be **resubmitted within seven (7) calendar days** after return.
Contractor will issue **schedule updates every Friday**. Subcontractor shall review each update and promptly notify Contractor of any disagreement.

heading: Delay Notice
verbatim_text: Subcontractor shall give written notice of any delay **within three (3) calendar days** after the start of the event, stating the cause and the estimated impact. Failure to give timely notice waives the claim.
trigger_desc: after the start of the event, stating the cause and the estimated impact

heading: No Damages for Delay
verbatim_text: Subcontractor's sole remedy for delay, hindrance or disruption, regardless of cause, shall be an **extension of time only**, and Subcontractor shall have no claim for damages or additional compensation.

heading: Liquidated Damages
verbatim_text: If Owner assesses liquidated damages under the Prime Contract, Contractor may pass those damages through to Subcontractor in proportion to Subcontractor's responsibility, at **$1,000 per calendar day**.

No change in the Work shall be performed without a **written Change Order or written directive** from Contractor, **except in an emergency** endangering life or property. Work performed without written authorization is at Subcontractor's own risk.
Subcontractor shall submit an itemized price for any requested change **within seven (7) calendar days** of Contractor's request.

heading: Claim Notice
verbatim_text: Any claim for additional time or money must be submitted in writing **within seven (7) calendar days of the event** giving rise to it. Claims not timely noticed are waived.
trigger_desc: of the event giving rise to it

heading: Time and Material Tickets
verbatim_text: T&M work shall be recorded on tickets **signed by Contractor's superintendent the same day** the work is performed. Unsigned tickets will not be paid.

Subcontractor warrants that all Work will be free of defects in materials and workmanship for **one (1) year from Owner's acceptance** of the Project, or longer where the Specifications require. Subcontractor shall correct defective Work promptly upon notice at no cost.
